map.电池 60 Wh、平均功耗 15 W、电源效率 0.9：可用≈60×0.9/15: Battery 60 Wh, average power 15 W, power efficiency 0.9: usable ≈60×0.9/15=3.6 h. Tip: under high load (gaming/rendering) the power doubles and the runtime halves, and low temperature also reduces the usable capacity.
map.为什么实际续航常低于标称？: Why is the actual runtime often below the rated one?
map.标称多按轻载/理想条件，实际受屏幕亮度、温升、老化和放电截止影响；深度放电还会加: The rating is mostly under light load/ideal conditions; actual results are affected by screen brightness, temperature rise, aging and the discharge cutoff; deep discharge also accelerates degradation.
map.放电深度影响寿命吗？: Does the depth of discharge affect the lifespan?
map.影响。锂电池浅充放（如 20%–80%）循环寿命明显长于满放满充；储能系统常限: Yes. Shallow charge/discharge of a lithium battery (e.g., 20%-80%) gives a notably longer cycle life than full charge/discharge; storage systems often limit the DoD to extend life.
